items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Wait you got me now, Jack.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you, I have nobody that played a baritone and the altos, I mean, eh? I mean, they figure that takes part in the baritone, which is the baritone, which is the altos. I mean, they figure that takes part in the baritone with the ad and the altos. So the guys just jump up and take a high tenor and altos.

Why are they using saxes in the bands now? Well I'll tell you, I have nobody to play the baritone and the altos. I mean so the guys just jump up and take them, a tenor and an alto play. I mean they figure that takes part, the baritone with the hands and the alto player play it, the alto. And what are you talking about that? No, that's not real, but it's brass band. Let's still start off with the first beat on the right foot now? Is that the way it's supposed to start? How do you mean? When you first start the…
They always do it the same way. They used to.
